parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: after the ETA conversion fails and req.reject(requeue=False) is called, there is no return, so eta stays None and the task falls through to the rate-limit/reserve path and runs immediately despite being rejected. Description B adds a note about the result backend not storing the failure, which is an extra point but does not change the core root cause shared with A.
